headline: S&S Power Switchgears bags a new order or contract
hook: New contract win for S&S Power
summary: S&S Power Switchgears Limited has formally informed the stock exchanges that it has secured a new order or contract. Details regarding the exact financial value of the contract and the client identity were not disclosed in the filing. For Indian retail investors, order wins are routine operational updates that reflect ongoing business activity in the micro-cap electrical equipment sector.
why_it_matters: Order inflow provides incremental revenue visibility for micro-cap shareholders.
